sovereign_country.strategic_role: 海湾阿拉伯国家自贸走廊、外资100%控股与印度洋海运枢纽

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Blank-Check Entity for Public Market Acquisition Mergers (SPAC)

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid – Civil law codified by Royal Sultani Decrees, with Islamic Sharia as a residual source of law and international commercial practice influencing corporate transactions
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Oman–United States Free Trade Agreement (effective 1 January 2009)
Oman–Singapore Free Trade Agreement (GCC–Singapore FTA framework, as a GCC member)
Oman–United Kingdom Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement
GCC Economic Agreement and Greater Arab Free Trade Area (GAFTA) participation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: AML/CFT Law promulgated by Royal Decree No. 30/2016, as amended by Royal Decree No. 20/2019 and implemented by Central Bank of Oman regulations and supervisory instructions; Commercial Companies Law promulgated by Sultani Decree No. 18/2019, as amended, including beneficial-owner registration obligations; Ministerial Decision No. 296/2020 of the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MCIIP) concerning registration and updating of beneficial owner data in the commercial register.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Memorandum and Articles of Association of each corporate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry of the jurisdiction in which the corporate shareholder is incorporated
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization in the country of origin followed by Consular Legalization at the Royal Embassy of the Sultanate of Oman

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing and incumbency listing directors and shareholders of each corporate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country Companies Registry or registered corporate service provider
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization and Consular Legalization by an Omani consular officer in the issuing country

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized passport copies and proof of residential address of every ultimate beneficial owner, director, and authorized signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of residence of each individual
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization by the Embassy of the Sultanate of Oman in the country of issue

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board resolution of the corporate shareholder approving the incorporation of the Omani Single Person Company and the UBO structure
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate secretary and chairperson of the corporate shareholder, attested by a notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization and Consular Legalization by the competent Omani diplomatic mission

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and erudite due-diligence questionnaire for the intended escrow and settlement accounts
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Maintaining bank of the corporate shareholder or ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank-notarized, with Consular Legalization only if required by the Omani licensed bank; otherwise direct submission to the bank under CBO KYC standards

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, officers, authorized signatories and counterparties against the United Nations Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, UK HM Treasury sanctions, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and Central Bank of Oman anti-money-laundering circulars and local sanctions notices. Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) must be identified through declaration and database screening; any PEP match requires enhanced due diligence, senior-management approval, and source-of-wealth/source-of-funds documentation before incorporation or escrow funding. Negative news and adverse-media checks must be maintained for at least five years in compliance with the Oman AML/CFT Law.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.beneficial_ownership_piercing_notes: Where a corporate chain is identified, piercing disregards intermediate entities and attributes ultimate control to natural persons holding 25% or more shares, voting rights, or effective control through any formal or informal mechanism; nominee shareholders and nominee directors must be disclosed, and failure to disclose the true UBO renders the SPCC license and registration voidable and subject to reporting to the Financial Intelligence Unit of the Sultanate of Oman.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Oman Business Platform (Invest Easy) of the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MCIIP) – Commercial Registry module
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The legal company name must be stated in Arabic script in the Commercial Register; a foreign-language name may be used in transliterated Arabic characters on trade documents, with a Latin-script transliteration shown as an ancillary trade name only. The Arabic name governs all legal filings, contracts, stamp duties, and court proceedings. The name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name, a reserved name, or a protected foreign branch; it must be written without abbreviations other than the mandatory legal-form suffix 'Single Person Company' or 'SPC'.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: On rejection, the applicant receives a written ground(s) in the Oman Business Platform inbox. The applicant may file an administrative objection with the MCIIP Name Clearance Committee within 10 business days using the same portal and paying the prescribed objection fee. If rejected after the administrative objection, the applicant may initiate judicial review before the Omani Administrative Court under the Code of Administrative Judiciary within 60 days. Concurrently, the applicant may reserve a new alternative name immediately; any extension of an accepted reservation for a further non-renewable period of 30 days may be requested through the portal before expiration by paying the extension tariff.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual-only office is not accepted for an Oman SPC engaged in blank-check/SPAC listing activity. The MCIIP and Central Bank of Oman expect a substantive physical registered office in the Sultanate of Oman, dedicated facilities for record keeping, and the capacity to receive original legal and escrow documentation. A serviced or shared office in Muscat may qualify only if it includes a dedicated workstation, permanent address, signed lease agreement, and authorised local process agent; a mail-forwarding or umbrella virtual address is non-compliant.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High – a conservatively estimated 70% probability of an unannounced MCIIP, Central Bank of Oman, or Financial Intelligence Unit inspection during the first 18 months after commercial registration and licensing, reflecting the enhanced AML/CFT profile of an ISIC 6499 blank-check acquisition vehicle and its escrow/wire payment rails.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name search and name reservation fee on Oman Business Platform
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MCIIP)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Arabic translation and notarization of foreign corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed official translator and notary public in Oman

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Consular legalization charges by Omani diplomatic mission for UBO bundle
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Embassy or Consulate of the Sultanate of Oman in the document-issue country

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial registration filing fee for Single Person Company (excluding minimum capital, which is not required)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MCIIP)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Beneficial owner registration and UBO declaration filing
Registered office serviced-lease arrangement in Muscat for first year
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed corporate service provider / landlord in Oman

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Preliminary SPAC licensing and ISIC 6499 activity assessment fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: MCIIP and Central Bank of Oman, where applicable
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff and regulatory assessment fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Escrow and settlement account pre-opening, KYC/AML onboarding and legal opinion
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Omani law firm and qualified bank

consular_legalization_route.hague_apostille_applicability: The Sultanate of Oman is not a contracting party to the Hague Apostille Convention of 1961; therefore foreign public documents submitted to the Omani commercial registry, financial intelligence unit, or licensed banks must be legalized through the Omani embassy or consulate in the issuing jurisdiction after notarization and appropriate home-country authentication.
consular_legalization_route.required_sequence: Notary public in country of origin -> competent home registry/responsible authority -> Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the country of origin (if applicable) -> Consular Legalization by the Embassy of the Sultanate of Oman -> certified Arabic translation in Oman where required.
consular_legalization_route.translation_obligation: All UBO supporting records, resolutions, certificates, and bank letters must be submitted in Arabic or accompanied by a certified Arabic translation made by an approved translator in Oman; the translation is a legally binding part of the filing bundle.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Oman Commercial Companies Law, Royal Decree No. 18/2019, as amended by Royal Decree No. 53/2019 and Royal Decree No. 77/2020, Part VII (Single Person Company), Articles 257-262; Capital Market Law, Royal Decree No. 80/2016; OFSA Listing and Disclosure Rules for Special Purpose Acquisition Companies; Muscat Stock Exchange Disclosure Standards.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) - Commercial Registration Department, acting through the single electronic window of the Invest Easy portal (investeasy.gov.om).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Unified Commercial Registration Application (Namoos) incorporating the notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association of the Single Person Company (SPC) and the activity declaration under ISIC 6499.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to an SPC under Royal Decree No. 18/2019; the sole shareholder must state a subscribed capital in the Memorandum and Articles of Association. As a condition of SPAC authorization, the Oman Financial Services Authority (OFSA) requires that at least 90% of gross IPO proceeds be deposited into a restricted trust escrow account held with an OFSA-licensed custodian bank, and that the sponsor demonstrate minimum initial capital adequacy of USD 250,000 (or equivalent) pending prospectus approval.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscription of the initial paid-up share capital be ratified and the share register be approved; RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Company be established at the address notified to the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion, and that the statutory seal and books be maintained thereat; RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Name] be appointed Chief Executive Officer, [Name] be appointed Chief Financial Officer, and [Name] be appointed Company Secretary, each authorized to execute regulatory filings, sign trust and escrow agreements, and open bank accounts; RESOLVED FURTHER, that the officers be directed to obtain the Oman Financial Services Authority SPAC authorization, municipal licensing, and all ancillary permits, and to transact all business incidental to the Company's constitution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Activity Code Pre-Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP - Commercial Names Department via the Invest Easy portal (investeasy.gov.om)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the Invest Easy e-portal and submit three ranked alternative trade names in approved Arabic-English transliteration (e.g., [Al-Afalak] SPAC SPC LLC). Simultaneously request activity-code pre-clearance for blank-check acquisition services under ISIC 6499 / NAICS 525990. The system screens against the national trade registry, prior registered marks, and Sharia-compliant naming rules. Upon approval, download the name clearance certificate valid for 90 days and attach it to the incorporation application.
required_dossiers: Completed e-name reservation form with three ranked names
Notarized copy of the sole shareholder's passport
Professional declaration of the authorized lawyer or auditor confirming the ISIC 6499 activity scope
Corporate authorization letter designating the filing agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: File a written objection with the MoCIIP Name Committee within 10 working days, providing revised transliterations and a legal memorandum distinguishing the conflicting mark; in parallel, submit two alternative names through the portal to prevent delay.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic Filing and Issuance of the Commercial Registration Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP - Commercial Registrar via the Invest Easy portal or the one-stop-shop counter
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge the unified commercial registration application together with the notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association of the Single Person Company. The constitutional documents must name the sole shareholder, confirm limited liability, declare the subscribed paid-up capital, and expressly include the SPAC acquisition and merger object. Pay the statutory registration and Official Gazette publication fees online. The Registrar verifies the documents, issues the Commercial Registration certificate bearing the CR number, and forwards the extract for publication in the Official Gazette.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association signed by the sole shareholder before a licensed Omani notary
Name clearance certificate
Notarized lease contract for a commercial registered office
Commercial Registration copy of the office landlord
Bank reference letter confirming the provenance of the shareholder's subscription funds
First-stage OFSA no-objection letter for the SPAC pre-approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to any deficiency notice within 15 days by resubmitting corrected documents through the portal. If the Registrar questions the SPAC object clause, file a certified legal opinion on ISIC 6499 and request elevation of the application to the MoCIIP Legal Department for a definitive ruling.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, Social Insurance, and Beneficial Ownership Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA), General Authority for Social Insurance (GASI), and the MoCIIP Beneficial Ownership Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 days of the Commercial Registration issuance, register the SPC with the OTA through its e-services portal to obtain the Tax Identification Number (TIN), and enrol for corporate income tax and VAT registration where applicable. File the ultimate beneficial owner declaration in the MoCIIP electronic registry. If natural persons are hired, register with GASI; for a stage-1 SPAC with no employees, file a nil-employee statutory declaration to be revisited upon closing of a business combination.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Commercial Registration (CR)
Memorandum and Articles of Association
Notarized lease agreement and attested proof of registered office address
Passport copy of the manager and sole shareholder
Ultimate Beneficial Owner declaration form
Corporate bank account confirmation letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If OTA rejects the registration due to address verification, provide the municipality-attested lease certificate and the official address tag. If GASI requires payroll evidence, submit a notarized nil-employee declaration pending SPAC authorization.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: OFSA Special Purpose Acquisition Company Authorization and Prospectus Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Oman Financial Services Authority (OFSA) - Capital Markets Supervision Department (successor to the Capital Market Authority)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the complete SPAC listing application comprising the draft prospectus, trust deed, escrow agreement with an OFSA-licensed custodian bank, sponsor track record, AML/CFT manual, and fit-and-proper declarations of all directors and officers. OFSA will verify the trust mechanics, the 90% escrow deposit rule, permissible safe-harbour investments of trust proceeds, redemption rights, and the 36-month business-combination outside date. Upon approval, the SPAC is registered as a listed vehicle on the Muscat Stock Exchange and the prospectus becomes effective for public subscription.
required_dossiers: Draft prospectus compliant with OFSA Disclosure Standards
Executed trust deed and escrow agreement with an OFSA-licensed custodian bank
Board resolutions adopting the corporate governance charter
AML/CFT compliance manual aligned with the Central Bank of Oman AML Law and FATF standards
Fit-and-proper questionnaires for directors, CEO, CFO, and company secretary
Legal opinions on the jurisdiction of incorporation and the tax treatment of trust proceeds
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Address OFSA comments in writing through the assigned case officer within 20 working days; file a supplemental prospectus where additional trust-asset disclosure is required. A refusal may be appealed to the OFSA Review Committee within 45 days under the Capital Market Law.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal License, Chamber of Commerce Membership, and Escrow Account Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Muscat Municipality (commercial licensing directorate) and the Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon issuance of the CR, obtain the municipal commercial license for the registered office following a premises inspection, and register the SPC as a member of OCCI. Pay the annual municipal and chamber fees. These approvals complete the company's legal standing to execute the SPAC trust deed and to instruct the custodian bank to open the segregated trust escrow account for the IPO proceeds.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Commercial Registration (CR)
Notarized lease contract and landlord CR copy
Civil Defence fire-safety clearance for the premises
Board resolution appointing the authorized signatories for escrow account opening
OCCI membership application form and passport copies of the sponsor
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipality flags a change-of-use or structural compliance issue, submit a stamped engineering statement demonstrating lawful office use. If OCCI membership is delayed, obtain a provisional membership receipt and present it to the custodian bank as interim evidence pending the final certificate.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Oman Financial Services Authority (OFSA) - Licensing and Supervision Department, jointly with the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) for the statutory commercial registration of the ISIC 6499 blank-check vehicle.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Single Person Company Commercial Registration (OM CR) and OFSA Special Purpose Acquisition Company (SPAC) Listing Authorization No. SPAC-L/20XX/OM

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environment Authority of the Sultanate of Oman (formerly the Ministry of Environment and Climate Affairs)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 3 (Registration) - the SPC performs purely administrative, financial, and escrow-management activities with no manufacturing, extraction, or land reclamation; a full Environmental Impact Assessment is not required. A conditional environmental registration under Ministerial Decision No. 179/2005 applies to sanitary wastewater discharge from the registered office.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero industrial process emissions and zero VOC discharges are applicable. Office sanitary wastewater discharged to the municipal sewerage network must comply with the Oman Environmental Standards under Ministerial Decisions No. 18/1993 and No. 179/2005: BOD not exceeding 25 mg/L, COD not exceeding 150 mg/L, TSS not exceeding 50 mg/L, pH 6.0-8.5. Any physical assets subsequently acquired through a SPAC business combination shall be subject to pre-acquisition environmental due diligence and separate permitting by the Environment Authority before operational transfer.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil Defence and Ambulance Directorate of the Royal Oman Police fire-safety certification for the registered office; Muscat Municipality building structural load inspection and change-of-use clearance; occupational health workplace clearance confirming safe premises, emergency egress, and adequate segregation of trust escrow records from general corporate books.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA) — the sole national revenue administration under the Oman Ministry of Finance; centralised e-registration and e-filing portal is 'Taxomania' at https://taxomania.gov.om. Export validation data is shared with the Oman Customs Directorate General (Royal Oman Police) via the 'Bayan' single-window customs system. No sub-national tax authority applies to an Oman-registered Single Person Company (SPC).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Procedure for a foreign-owned Single Person Company (OM-SPC): (1) Obtain the Commercial Registration (CR) from the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MOCIIP), together with the Foreign Investment Licence where the sole shareholder is non-GCC and the activity is reserved; the CR number is the master business identifier. (2) Within 30 days of CR issuance, apply to the OTA via Taxomania for the corporate Tax Identification Number (TIN) by submitting the CR, notarised constitutional documents, shareholder identity documents (passport/Civil ID), the appointed manager/board resolution, registered office proof and audited opening statement if required; the OTA issues a Tax Card with the TIN. Non-resident shareholders must appoint a local tax agent/auditor for service of process and filing if no resident manager is designated. (3) Separately apply for the VAT Identification Number (VATIN) through Taxomania once aggregate taxable supplies in Oman exceed OMR 38,500 over any rolling 12-month period (voluntary VAT registration at OMR 19,250); the VATIN is issued after the OTA verifies the TIN, CR and bank account. (4) For future export activity, register as an exporter in the Bayan customs system. All OTA registration steps are electronic and cross-linked with the CR data.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Oman offers no check-the-box, no Section 8832-style pass-through election, and no partnership transparency election for an Omani Single Person Company. The SPC is mandatorily taxed as a separate corporate person under the Oman Income Tax Law (Royal Decree 28/2009), regardless of the foreign shareholder's tax attributes. No group fiscal unity or consolidated filing election is available. The foreign shareholder cannot elect flow-through treatment for Oman tax purposes. Tax treaty benefits, where applicable, are claimed through the OTA competent-authority process rather than by domestic entity election; hybrid mismatch elections are not recognised under Oman's entity classification rules.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) — Royal Decree 121/2020 and Executive Regulations (Ministry Decision No. 36/2021)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: OMR 38,500 (approx. USD 100,000) of cumulative taxable supplies in any consecutive 12-month period for mandatory VAT registration; voluntary registration threshold is OMR 19,250 (approx. USD 50,000). For non-resident suppliers making taxable supplies in Oman without an Omani establishment, registration is mandatory at the same threshold, or where required under specific OTA instructions, without a threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Oman does not yet operate a mandatory real-time fiscal clearance model or a continuous-transaction-control API for every VAT invoice. The OTA is progressively rolling out a mandatory e-invoicing framework through Taxomania; when fully effective, registered persons must issue invoices using OTA-certified systems and transmit invoice data electronically to the OTA tax data lake. Currently, VAT invoices may be issued in paper or electronic format (PDF/XML), must contain the full VATIN, supply description, date, tax rate and VAT payable, and must be retained for 5 years. There is no requirement for an ad valorem fiscal stamp or a government clearance stamp on export invoices; export evidence is validated through the Bayan customs declaration and matching of payment remittance data.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: The SPC may zero-rate (a) goods sold for export where the goods physically leave Oman and the GCC member-state territory within the statutory export period, (b) international transport of goods/passengers, (c) services directly connected to goods being exported or imported and (d) services supplied to a non-resident outside the GCC where the recipient is outside the GCC, the legal effect and actual use of the services occur outside Oman, and the services are not services related to Omani immovable property or performed while the recipient is physically present in Oman. For an OM-SPC acting as a SPAC, zero-rating is available for cross-border merger-acquisition facilitation, due diligence, escrow administration and advisory services supplied to a foreign target/foreign sponsor, provided the contract designates a foreign recipient, the service is used abroad, and contemporaneous evidence of cross-border payment and professional delivery is retained. Goods exported through a customs warehouse with a valid Bayan declaration also qualify. The SPC must document the export within the exporter's records; no minimum value threshold applies for zero-rating.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (electronic Bayan declaration with registered exporter code and customs receipt number)
Bill of Lading (ocean/airway bill; for land or GCC-transit exports, a CMR/Carnet TIR with the exit-border seal from Oman Customs)
Inward Remittance Certificate (bank-issued Swift MT103/MT950, or OTA-approved foreign exchange realisation record for export proceeds)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The OTA and Oman Customs operate automated risk-based matching between export declarations, shipping data, VAT refund claims and FX remittance records. If the export evidence bundle is incomplete, rejected as forged, or the goods are not shown to have left the GCC customs territory, the SPC is subject to retrospective clawback of the zero-rating benefit: the 5% VAT is reassessed on the export supply, input VAT previously recovered in connection with the export is disallowed, and statutory late-payment penalties apply from the original due date. Deliberate fraudulent zero-rating, including fictitious bills of lading, circular FX remittances, or phantom cargo, triggers administrative fines up to OMR 100,000, criminal prosecution with imprisonment of up to 3 years, and a criminal fine of up to double the tax evaded, under the Oman VAT Law and OTA enforcement rules. In addition, the OTA may revoke the VAT registration, blacklist the SPC from simplified exporting procedures, and impose joint liability on the sole shareholder and the liquidation sponsor where assets have been stripped.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Oman (CBO), acting as the foreign exchange administration authority; Oman Tax Authority for remittance tax clearances; Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) for investment licensing and corporate registration.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Oman maintains broad current-account convertibility under IMF Article VIII and applies an open capital-account framework for foreign investment. The Omani Rial (OMR) is pegged to the United States Dollar (USD) at a fixed official rate of 1 OMR = 2.60028 USD. There are no exchange-control quotas or prior CBO approvals for ordinary profit remittances by a foreign-owned Single Person Company (SPC). However, banks require documentary proof of the underlying transaction, source-of-funds verification, and compliance with anti-money laundering and counter-financing-of-terrorism (AML/CFT) reporting requirements. Dividend, interest, royalty, and other remittances to non-residents may be subject to Oman withholding tax; the paying bank will require a tax clearance certificate or withholding tax settlement acknowledgement from Oman Tax Authority before releasing large outward remittances. Capital account convertibility is also broadly available for FDI-backed SPCs, provided the entity is properly licensed and registered with MoCIIP and the bank's KYC file contains a board-signed resolution authorizing the capital movement.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Oman does not impose mandatory export-proceeds surrender rules or minimum conversion ratios for Omani exporters. Export receipts may be retained in foreign currency accounts at CBO-licensed banks. There is no statutory surrender timeline for export proceeds and the mandatory conversion ratio is 0%. For the SPAC vehicle at hand, this is not directly applicable because the entity is not a goods exporter; nevertheless, any incidental fee or development income received in foreign currency may be kept in USD or converted to OMR at the prevailing interbank rate without a CBO conversion obligation. Banks may require underlying export invoices, customs declarations, or service agreements only for AML transaction-verification purposes.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low-Medium for the SPAC’s core treasury and liquidation operations. Offshore digital electronic-money institutions and non-bank payment service providers (for example Wise, Payoneer, or MultiPass-type platforms) are not licensed by the Central Bank of Oman to conduct payment services in or into Oman. They cannot access Omani RTGS infrastructure, provide OMR-denominated local clearing, or legally hold funds in a manner acceptable to the CBO for escrow and M&A settlement functions. Foreign EMIs may be used only as ancillary rails for collecting or disbursing funds in foreign currencies outside Oman where no OMR settlement or Omani resident payment initiation occurs. Legal constraints derive from the CBO’s Retail Payment Services Regulatory Framework, Oman’s Banking Law, and the Law on Combating Money Laundering and Terrorism Financing; operating an unlicensed payment service from or into Oman may constitute a regulatory violation. Therefore, primary escrow, capital-injection, and acquisition-disbursement accounts must be held with CBO-licensed banks.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mandatory physical presence is generally required for at least one director, all authorized signatories, and the ultimate beneficial owner when opening corporate bank accounts for a newly formed foreign-owned Oman SPC. Remote-only account opening is not available for an SPAC vehicle unless the same banking group already has a very strong existing relationship and the account opening is augmented by in-branch identity verification at the Omani branch or a recognized overseas branch under institutional global KYC standards. In practice, Omani banks require an in-person interview at the home branch in Muscat or the governorate where the company is registered; a video call alone is not sufficient for an initial onboarding. The process requires originals or duly attested copies of passports, valid residence visas or investor entry permits, the commercial registration certificate of the SPC, the executed articles of association in Arabic (often with English translation), the board/shareholder resolution on account opening, a certified copy of the company’s tax card, and proof of the office address. Failure to satisfy the physical interview requirement will cause application rejection or indefinite processing delay.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Blank-check SPAC classification with a broadly drafted investment mandate and no underlying trade or operating revenue causes banks to apply enhanced risk-rating.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A full corporate and AML KYC pack comprising: certificate of incorporation and registered office proof; MoCIIP commercial registration; memorandum and articles of association; issued and paid-up capital evidence; complete share register with ultimate beneficial owners; the sponsor’s conflict-of-interest statement; a detailed SPAC prospectus or investment mandate; the escrow and trust deed executed with a licensed escrow agent; board resolutions authorizing account opening and capital commitments; source-of-funds and source-of-wealth disclosure; audited preliminary financial statements or sponsor commitment letters; and professional references from the sponsor’s home-country bank and legal counsel.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-value inbound capital injections or outbound wire disbursements to jurisdictions with no visible M&A target, or in which the SPAC is not yet fully licensed as a public acquisition vehicle, trigger enhanced transaction due diligence.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: The bank-required transaction file should include board-approved capital injection minutes; the investor wiring instructions with exact purpose codes; evidence of the committed capital being based on bona fide sponsor commitments; the acquisition term sheet or non-binding letter of intent; a valuation memorandum for the target; a sanctions and PEP screening report on the counterparty, target shareholders, and beneficiary banks; an AML/CFT due-diligence questionnaire completed by the target’s management; and a legal sign-off from both Omani and target-jurisdiction counsel confirming adherence to applicable securities and anti-money-laundering laws.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The presence of politically exposed persons (PEPs), split shareholding through opaque trusts, or investors resident in high-risk jurisdictions is a common red flag.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Enhanced due diligence report prepared by a CBO-accepted AML advisor; PEP declaration forms for all board members and beneficial owners; copy of a registered trust deed or foundation charter where applicable; independent sanctions-watchlist screening certificates; source-of-wealth reports including asset title deeds, employment contracts, audited financial statements, and bank references; sworn statutory declarations explaining the commercial rationale; and a legal opinion on compliance with Oman’s AML/CFT Law and the relevant tax information exchange treaties.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound sponsor capital should be routed via SWIFT MT103 from the investor’s licensed overseas bank directly to the SPC’s USD-denominated or OMR-denominated operational or capital escrow account at a CBO-licensed Omani bank. The remittance instruction must clearly state the purpose of payment in SWIFT field 70 as 'CAPITAL INJECTION – OMAN SPC SHARE CAPITAL' or 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION – ESCROW FOR SPAC ACQUISITE PROGRAM' to ensure correct booking. For SPAC commitment funding under a subscription agreement, banks require the corresponding signed deed of adherence, escrow agreement, and board resolution. Oman does not operate a mandatory purpose-code regime, but the receiving bank will apply its internal transaction code and may require supporting documents for transfers above approximately OMR 30,000 equivalent. Funds can be credited in USD without mandatory conversion to OMR. If funds are provided as debt rather than equity, a registered loan agreement is required and the interest portion will be subject to Oman withholding tax rules; for a SPAC, capital injections should remain in core equity or committed sponsor tier-equity form to avoid recharacterization by CBO and Oman Tax Authority.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade and acquisition disbursements should clear through the licensed Omani banking network. Operational expenses and professional fees are routed by SWIFT MT103 on a single-customer-credit-transfer basis. Interbank settlement to correspondent banks for large M&A consideration transfers is handled by SWIFT MT202 on a bank-to-bank basis, with the underlying MT103 or escrow payout instruction retained to evidence the party and purpose. A commercial import letter of credit (SWIFT MT700) and its subsequent MT754/MT799 amendments may be used only where the acquisition program includes physical goods, commodities, or equipment; for a pure SPAC equity purchase, the acquired shares are settled via MT103/MT202 escrow repayment instructions rather than an LC, because an LC is a documentary trade instrument and not an appropriate clearing mechanism for share transfer payments. All outbound disbursements above the bank’s threshold must be supported by: a board-approved disbursement resolution; the executed transaction agreement or escrow release condition certificate; tax withholding clearance from Oman Tax Authority where payments constitute dividends, interest, professional fees, or royalties; and complete KYC/AML verification of the beneficiary bank and ultimate recipient.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forwards between USD and OMR executed with a CBO-licensed Omani bank for genuine outstanding commercial or investment exposure; typically permitted for up to 12 months and require evidence of the underlying SPAC commitment or acquisition obligation.

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing USD/OMR for hedging exposure to the pegged exchange rate, acceptable when booked with a reputable non-Omani bank outside the CBO’s direct regulatory perimeter, provided the instrument is clearly documentary backed by a hedging policy and cannot create a speculative position.

Cross-currency interest rate swaps and basis swaps with licensed banks for matching sponsor capital and acquisition liabilities in USD, OMR, or other acquisition-denominated currencies, subject to Omani bank internal credit approval and a board-approved treasury and risk management policy.

Plain-vanilla FX options or call-spread structures are not explicitly prohibited but are subject to strict CBO guidance regarding genuine underlying exposure; they are permissible only when embedded within a board-approved hedging framework and not offered as leveraged speculative products to the SPAC.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MOCIIP) - Commercial Registration Directorate
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Calendar-year renewal; submission required on or before 31 December of each year. MOCIIP provides a 30-day grace period after expiry.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly late penalty of OMR 50 (USD 130) begins after the grace period; continued non-renewal for 90 days triggers administrative suspension and, after 120 days, strike-off of the commercial register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Audited Financial Statements and Auditor's Compliance Certificate
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: MOCIIP - Companies Registration Directorate and Oman Tax Authority (OTA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after the financial year-end; for a calendar-year SPC, no later than 30 April of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file audited statements blocks CR renewal and subjects the company to fines of up to OMR 5,000 (USD 13,000) under the Oman Commercial Companies Law (Royal Decree 18/2019).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Return (Non-Petroleum and CGT Regime)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 April following the tax year end; tax period for an SPC is the calendar year unless otherwise approved by OTA.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late submission penalty of OMR 200 (USD 520), plus OMR 200 per additional quarter of delay; subsequent enforcement includes attachment of bank accounts and seizure of corporate assets.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Confirmation of Beneficial Owner and Share Register
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually during CR renewal window, with updated register of members and UBO schedule; any transfer of shares must be reflected within 15 days of the transaction.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance with UBO register maintenance incurs fines from OMR 1,000 to OMR 5,000 (USD 2,600 to USD 13,000); unrecorded share transfers are void against the company and may expose the SPC to strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Statistical Return to the National Centre for Statistics and Information
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Centre for Statistics and Information (NCSI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days of the end of the statistical year, typically by 31 March.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to submit incurs an administrative fine of OMR 500 (USD 1,300) under the Omani Statistics Law and may impede future commercial registrations.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: All Omani commercial companies, including a Single Person Company (SPC), must appoint a licensed auditor and undergo an annual statutory audit regardless of turnover, asset, or employee thresholds. No small-company exemption exists for an Omani SPC under the Commercial Companies Law (Royal Decree 18/2019).
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as endorsed in Oman; entities below the OMOIC SME thresholds may use IFRS for SMEs, subject to MOCIIP acceptance.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: An SPC must maintain a Register of Beneficial Owners (UBO Register) and confirm its contents annually with MOCIIP during the commercial registration renewal cycle. Any shareholding transfer by the sole member requires a notarial deed of transfer, immediate entry in the Register of Members, and UBO Register update within 15 days; the MOCIIP annual confirmation must reflect all completed transfers.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Contracts and Conflict-of-Interest Transactions

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 4,000 - USD 10,000 per year for a certified independent audit of an SPAC holding entity with escrow and trust accounts
